blind.description: A stylized burnt tree stump featuring a thick trunk that terminates in three broken, jagged stubs at the top. The bottom splays outwards into numerous thick, gnarled roots that rest directly on the ground. The surface is textured with deep bark grooves in charcoal grey and soot-black, intersected by warm reddish-brown clefts representing exposed inner wood or glowing embers. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and fully modeled with no floating or broken fragments.
blind.from_above: Appears as a radial, multi-pronged star or spider-like cluster of root tendrils radiating outwards from a central stump cluster with exposed reddish sheared tips.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 4.5 to 5 ft tall (reaching the chest or shoulder of the 5 ft 9 in scale figure) and about 4.5 to 5 ft wide across the root spread.

notes: Height-to-width proportion is somewhat squatter than requested catalog ratio due to wide splayed root footprint
